text:
jordan: Short sync: want a compact benchmark narrative for launch collateral. Deliverables: 3 visuals, 2 headline variants, a micro calc for sales, and a simple lead-routing playbook. Keep claims conservative.
mica: agreed. suggest shards: short-chat, agent-long, embeddings. keep runs small so we can ship quickly.
felix: visuals idea: 1) unit-cost vs median latency scatter, 2) p50-p99 ladder, 3) per-slice bars showing cache+batch impact.
anya: copy tones: engineer-first and product-outcome. engineer-first: "Bench-backed serving: predictable tails and clear unit economics." product-outcome: "Faster answers, smaller bills."
jordan: sales calc snippet: show $/1k and $/1M token examples and a sample with "up to X%" phrasing (appendix has exact).
mica: bench-bot run command (small):
```
/bench quick --model rwd-small --slices short,agent,embed --tokens 2500 --seeds 2 --out ./tmp
```
felix: chart specs (short):
- Chart A: x=median latency (ms), y=$ per 1k tokens, points=model variants, annotate p95
- Chart B: latency percentiles (p50,p75,p90,p95,p99) lines by slice
- Chart C: rows=short/agent/embed, bars=baseline vs cache vs batch+quant, metric=$/req
anya: inbound routing rules: tag "bench" on prompt upload; demo route if monthly tokens > 5M or asks private deploy; webinar RSVPs get CSV + one-sheet.
jordan: webinar hook draft: "A lab-backed playbook for balancing p95 latency and inference spend. Bring a prompt set 1 and well slice it live." CTA: "Upload prompts when you RSVP."
mica: social microcopy: "We ran a lab across real slices  median latency down to ~100ms, unit cost down up to ~50% on common patterns. Try your prompts." (use "up to" in hero)
felix: bench-bot: queued quick jobs. outputs will be CSV + PNGs + short summary. use `/bench status` to follow.
anya: timeline: mock PNGs by EOD Mon, copy Tue AM, webinar Wed. keep hero conservative; exact numbers in appendix.
jordan: great. felix + mica pair on runs; anya on sales one-pager and routing bullets; ill draft landing + headline variants and drop back here. short deliverables only.
bench-bot: quick-run started. ETA ~20m. will post attachments here.
mica: thanks team, Ill grab the first PNGs and paste them once ready.
felix: copy note: designers please leave space for a 1-row appendix mapping app type -> recommended config (chat: keep cache warm; agent: batch small; embed: async pooling).
jordan: closing loop: visuals (A/B colorways), short social post, sales calc, webinar blurb, routing playbook, bench quick command samples. deliverable copy <=2 lines each.
bench-bot: run complete: attached CSV and 3 PNGs (posted to shared drive).
mica: perfect. dropping mock PNG links in the doc now. thank you!
